evals.name: audit-broken-landing-page
evals.prompt: Here's the exact HTML our pricing page serves: /tmp/opencode/og-eval/inputs/landing-broken.html. When anyone drops the link in Slack or LinkedIn it shows a tiny grey card with just 'acme.example'. Can you tell me what's wrong and give me the corrected head?
evals.expected_output: A prioritised list of what is wrong (missing og:type and og:url, relative og:image, duplicate og:title, og:site_name outside head, en-US locale) plus a corrected <head> with absolute URLs, og:url matching canonical, image dimensions and alt.

assertions.text: Identifies that og:type is missing
Identifies that og:url is missing
Identifies that the og:image value is relative and must be absolute
Identifies the duplicate og:title and explains that the first value wins
Identifies that og:site_name sits outside <head>
Provides a corrected head where og:url equals the canonical URL and og:image is absolute https
Corrected head includes og:image:alt and width/height of 1200x630
Does not invent property names that are not in the Open Graph protocol

evals.name: fix-astro-blog-layout
evals.prompt: Blog posts on our Astro site unfurl with only the site name - no headline, no image. The layout that renders every post's <head> is /tmp/opencode/og-eval/inputs/astro-blog/src/layouts/BlogPost.astro and the site URL is in astro.config.mjs next to it. Make the social metadata right for every post, and write the updated layout to <OUTPUT_DIR>/BlogPost.astro (keep the rest of the file intact).
evals.expected_output: Updated Astro layout emitting og:title, og:type=article, absolute og:url and og:image derived from Astro.site, image dimensions and alt, og:description, og:site_name, og:locale, and article:published_time from the publishedAt prop.

assertions.text: Emits og:title from the post title prop
Emits og:type with the value article
Builds og:url as an absolute URL from Astro.site rather than a hardcoded domain
Emits an absolute og:image URL for the post, with a sane fallback when heroImage is absent
Includes og:image:alt, og:image:width and og:image:height
Emits og:description, og:site_name and a valid og:locale
Emits article:published_time as an ISO 8601 value
Leaves the existing title, description, canonical link and slot intact without duplicating them

evals.name: clean-page-regression
evals.prompt: Quick pre-ship check: is the social metadata on /tmp/opencode/og-eval/inputs/clean-article.html ready to go, or is anything missing? Be specific.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the four required properties are present and valid, that the image has dimensions/type/alt, locale and article metadata are correct. Optional suggestions must not be presented as defects.

assertions.text: States that all four required properties are present
Does not claim any required property is missing
Confirms og:url matches the canonical URL and og:image is absolute
Distinguishes optional improvements from actual problems
